geometry: Two rows of twelve square-cornered seven-segment glyphs, built from explicit vector paths over dim segment backgrounds. The 143 by 38 sprite has 9 by 14 glyphs on an 11-unit pitch, with two-unit segment strokes; rows begin at y=3 and y=22. Colors match the opaque black background and the four original green shades.
limitations: None observed. Native and 8x renders were visually inspected; the native rendering matches every source pixel.
